name: Prometheus & Grafana Observability Integration
description: Integration pack for Prometheus and Grafana, providing connectivity to PromQL metric queries, Prometheus Alertmanager alert rules, Grafana dashboard provisioning API, and custom SLA/SLO visualization dashboards.

capabilities.name: Monitoring, Observability & SRE / Scale & Performance Optimization
capabilities.description: Integrates Prometheus metric scraping, PromQL alert rules, Alertmanager webhooks, and Grafana dashboards. Integrates PromQL latency percentiles (p95/p99), CPU/Memory utilization trends, and capacity planning graphs.

checklists.name: Prometheus & Grafana Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Prometheus HTTP API endpoints, Alertmanager webhook receivers, and Grafana API key provisioning.

items.statement: Prometheus Server HTTP API (/api/v1/query) executes PromQL queries and returns metric series.
Prometheus Alertmanager rules route firing alerts to PagerDuty/Slack webhook receivers.
Grafana Service Account API Key provisions dashboards via Grafana REST API.

reviewGates.name: Prometheus & Grafana Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Site Reliability Engineer confirms that Prometheus metric scraping, Alertmanager rules, and Grafana dashboards function correctly.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Prometheus & Grafana integration verify PromQL metric querying and Grafana dashboard provisioning?
